name: Flight Mode

features.name: Bombs
features.description: Clear their whole row and reel when no wins remain.

features.name: xHole
features.description: Re-shuffles the board when nothing else happens.

review:
Flight Mode is a 6x4 Nolimit City slot with a much gentler Medium volatility rating. When no wins remain, bombs clear their entire row and reel, and xHole sucks the symbols off the reels and spits them back out in new positions.

Multiplier Increasers add their value to the next multiplier when they land. The cap is 5,051x, low for this studio, which makes Flight Mode one of the most approachable modern Nolimit games.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
